decisions.reason: Prioritizing conversion performance does not alter the required reference basis or adaptation method; those instructions remain valid unchanged.
The conversion objective is compatible with the existing strong, direct, viral hook requirements and does not necessarily change any of their attributes.
The source establishes an overall performance priority but does not select, cancel, or modify the testimonial presentation or content source.
The conversion priority does not change the required video count, duration, or aspect ratios.
The source does not prescribe a different editing pace or cut standard; the existing retention-focused cut requirement remains valid.
The performance objective does not change responsibility for supplying footage, voiceover, and script.
The source concerns optimization of the video ad creative and neither resumes nor changes the deferred landing-page and tracking audit.
Prioritizing conversions over aesthetics does not remove or modify the required realistic native-looking UGC visual style.
